title: 'Mundic', Mexico, to Luis León de la Barra, Paris, two cipher telegrams of 13 Feb and 15 Mar 1912 (catalogue 1463): letter substitution solved from the ciphertext, key frozen on one telegram and tested on the other; both read in part

documents.shelfmark: CEHM-Carso, Fondo X-1 (Manuscritos de Francisco León de la Barra), X-1.3.207.1
documents.route: 'Mundic', Mexico -> Luis L. de la Barra, 9 rue Alfred de Vigny, Paris (telegraphic address Barradella)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the form. Key recovered from the ciphertext of this telegram and X-1.3.239.1.

transcription.notes: Two passes (about 0.75x, then 2x crops); two letters disagreed and were settled on the crops. Pass 2 was not blind to a first solve.

documents.route: 'Mundic', Mexico -> Luis L. de la Barra, Paris

transcription.notes: Two passes (about 0.7x, then 2x-3x crops); three letters disagreed and were settled on the crops; the f of fwxov is the weakest sign. Pass 2 was not blind to a first solve.

system.summary: Lower-case letter substitution of Spanish, 21 cipher letters seen. Two cipher letters stand for two plain letters each: n = t and u (both in situación), u = n and w (necesario, Wilson). Single exceptions read as slips: o = o once (embajador; i elsewhere), e = l once (vuelvas; d elsewhere), one l dropped (resuelvas). 207 keeps word division; 239 is in groups of five. The key sheet in the same fondo (X-1.5.466.1) is a different key.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment on the forms; CEHM catalogue: 'En clave', no translation. Two web searches (12 Nov 2026: 'León de la Barra August 1913 New York Boaz Long telegram recognition Huerta'; '"Mundic" León de la Barra telegrama 1912 clave') found no edition or decipherment of these telegrams; the vetting of 2 Nov 2026 found nothing in DECODE, Tomokiyo or Lasry. Narváez 2019 (SRE book) not read.

conditions.human_role: WAINUT set the task (catalogue 1463) and the rules; AI language-model agents transcribed, solved, froze the key, ran the held-out test, read and checked. No target-specific human intervention. No human palaeographer checked the text.
tools: scripts in this folder (decryption, held-out test, mark check)
simulated-annealing substitution solver with Spanish 4-gram statistics (Project Gutenberg texts)
models: AI language-model agents (WAINUT), viewing the images

solution.what: Images of X-1.3.207.1 and X-1.3.239.1 and the key sheet X-1.5.466.1 fetched from visor.cehm.org.mx (direct JPG), one at a time, at least 1.6 s apart, no login.
Key sheet X-1.5.466.1 ('Abecedario y su clave', Secretaría Particular del Presidente, to F. L. de la Barra) applied in both directions: no Spanish (scripts/keysheet_test.py).

Simulated annealing on the 150 letters of both telegrams with Spanish 4-grams gave fragments (considera, necesario, situación incierta, tendencia); finished by hand with the word division of 207 and checked on the crops.

Key frozen from telegram 207 alone (19 letters), applied to 239: 72 of 75 letters right (96.0%), 0 wrong, 3 not in the frozen key (l twice, t once). Weakness: 239 had been looked at during the first joint machine solve.
Both decrypted mechanically and read with every departure marked; scripts/check_marks.py passes.

Independent blind review by an AI language-model agent that did not take part in the solve: signs re-read from the scans before opening the transcriptions, scripts re-run, held-out count reproduced, texts read as sentences against the translations. One sign of 207 (L2 g1, 8th letter) may be b rather than o; every other sign agrees. 207 grade B, 239 grade A.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 149 tokens, 21 types, es-modern order 4: reading -2.899 per letter; random keys -7.181 (z 5.9); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.68 (mean -3.828, z 6.7); annealer on the real text -2.94. Verdict: pass.

Integration check (12 Nov 2026), own decoder from key_frozen.tsv: telegram 239 decodes to 'aclaraciones buena impresion situacion incierta tendencia general vivo anhelo de paz'; held-out count reproduced (58 of 60 on lines 2-4 by heldout.py, line 1 by hand; 0 wrong). Own control with the lang es-modern 4-gram model: frozen-key decode of 239 -2.317 per letter against 2000 keys with the same plain values shuffled over the cipher letters, mean -6.91, best -3.99 (z 5.1). The freezing order rests on the contributor's record (single commit); both telegrams had been solved together before.

Integration check (12 Nov 2026): images X-1.3.207.1.0001 and X-1.3.239.1.0001 fetched from the CEHM viewer (no refusal) and compared with the transcriptions at full resolution: all groups agree at that reading; the doubtful signs the contributor names stay doubtful. Read share recounted strictly: 207 0.70, 239 0.917, together 0.818: read in part confirmed.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.236; polyphony 0.047; 1 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.94

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only solve of the two telegrams together (same sender, same key), frozen on 207 and tested on 239.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Strict count by the README read bar, from the reading files: cipher words verbatim from the signs, a word with a marked repair or not read counts as not read. 207: 7 of 10 (0.70); 239: 11 of 12 (0.917); together 18 of 22 = 0.818. (The contributor's earlier field gave 1.0 as the share of cipher letters with a key value; that is key coverage, not reading.)

texts.label: Telegram of 13 Feb 1912
texts.summary: Mundic applauds Luis de la Barra's decision to return: Ambassador (Henry Lane) Wilson considers it necessary that he come back soon to help.
texts.note: 10 cipher words: 7 verbatim, 3 with a marked one-letter repair; no holes. Reading checker on reading_207_sentences.txt: clean share 0.5 (1 of 2 sentences).

reading_review.note: Read as sentences against the translation: two coherent telegraphic sentences with 3 marked one-letter repairs and no holes. Signs re-read blind from the scan agree except one (L2 g1, 8th letter), which may be b rather than o and would then remove one repair.

texts.label: Telegram of 15 Mar 1912
texts.summary: Explanations given, good impression; the situation uncertain; the general tendency a keen desire for peace.
texts.note: 12 cipher words: 11 verbatim, the opening h not read. Reading checker on reading_239_sentences.txt: clean share 1.0 (2 of 2 sentences).

reading_review.note: Read as sentences against the translation: coherent, with only the opening h unread. Signs re-read blind from the scan agree in full, and the held-out count (72/75 letters, 0 wrong) is reproduced.

gaps.detail: one letter before 'aclaraciones'; nothing on the form decides the word (perhaps 'Hechas').
the blind review found the sign may be this hand's b (= o), which would make 'embajador' verbatim; not settled on a 5x crop, so the repair stays marked.
an unusual f (pass 1 f, pass 2 t); the blind review also reads f.

gaps.item: X-1.3.207.1: three one-letter slips read from sense (embajador, resuelvas, vuelvas)
gaps.detail: ten cipher words give no second place for any of them.
